review.verdict: Clean blueprint style and correct human/robot casting, but clipped doors, an official bleeding off the right edge, and an ambiguous pointing pose (instead of hanging the badge) leave the scene unbalanced and partly broken — plus it repeats a recent split-panel composition. Needs a layout and pose fix before it can pass.
revisionNotes: Both door-left and door-right are clipped at the bottom safe area (lint: y 655-1038) — scale doors down to ~0.7 or raise their y-anchor so full building height is inside frame.
The official is pushed past the right safe-area edge (lint: x up to 1066) with the pointing arm nearly off-canvas — move anchor to x≈0.78 and scale to ~0.85.
Official's pose ('point' to the right) doesn't match the brief's action of hanging the eye-badge over the door — swap to a reach/hang pose so he visibly interacts with the badge.
Official's body overlaps the eye-badge and right door edge — add a clear gap between the figure and the badge so the hanging gesture reads cleanly instead of merging shapes.

Top half of the 1080x1080 canvas is empty blueprint grid — raise the whole group (doors, shield, badge, official) toward center or add blueprint furniture (title block, dimension marks) to balance the square.
Composition repeats the vertical-seam split-panel device already used in a recent slopper — try a different split (stacked top/bottom, or offset diagonal seam) for novelty.

review.verdict: A clean, legible blueprint gag that correctly casts the official as human and the eye/shield as props, but the two door towers read as separate kiosks rather than one split building, and its palette leans close to recent blueprint sloppers.
revisionNotes: Merge the two door towers into a single building silhouette with a visible center seam per the brief ('one building wearing two faces') — right now they read as two separate standalone kiosks/scanners rather than one split structure.

Give the official a clear 'hanging the badge' beat (one arm reaching up to the badge, maybe holding a small tool) instead of a two-armed cheer pose, so the action matches the scene's intended gesture.
Add a small stamping hand/arm over the left shield so both panels show a matching action beat — currently only the right side has a human doing something, the left only shows the finished RISK stamp.

Novelty: the navy/white/yellow blueprint palette and grid closely match the last two blueprint sloppers (TOO LATE, PLEDGE); shift the accent color or add a warm fill block to differentiate this piece.
Nudge the RISK label up ~10px and scale to 0.85 so the rotated text clears the padlock icon below it without crowding.

Consider tying the floating dimension line at top to the building width more explicitly (extend endpoints to align with outer door edges) so it reads as a deliberate blueprint annotation rather than a stray ruler.
